page_camera.depth_why: The reference target the kit is proved on, not a shipping game: a three.js PerspectiveCamera with its documented constructor defaults, near 0.1 and far 2000 (fov 50, aspect 1; https://threejs.org/docs/pages/PerspectiveCamera.html), one scene unit taken as one metre. The 24-bit integer depth buffer is to confirm (UNVERIFIED): WebGL's depth context attribute (https://registry.khronos.org/webgl/specs/latest/1.0/) and three.js WebGLRenderer's depth option promise only a depth buffer of at least 16 bits.

edges.crease_why: model-kit's shading angle, 35 degrees, the same as its bars: a real-style rim turns in steps of at most 30 degrees and then 50 onto the top, so the ink draws one crease there; a toy rim turns only in steps of at most 30, so it draws none.
